open_points.subject: A11 unknown outcome resolution (`not_applied`)
open_points.text: A11 rule 3 says "the kernel writes one further NodeExecution with the next attempt number" and then says "`not_applied`: no further NodeExecution".
open_points.question: When the owner resolves an `unknown` effect as `not_applied`, is an additional NodeExecution written or not?
options: Write a second NodeExecution for the resolution event
Write no additional NodeExecution; keep only the original `outcome_unknown` record
open_points.default_guess: Write no additional NodeExecution for `not_applied` (follow the bullet and required test intent).

open_points.subject: A11 attempt numbering semantics
open_points.text: A11 rule 1 says "`attempt_number` counts from 1 every record the kernel writes about that element" while also saying EffectAttempt and NodeExecution of one send "carry the same number".
open_points.question: Does `attempt_number` increment per send-attempt, or per individual record row?
options: Increment per send-attempt; EffectAttempt and NodeExecution share one number
Increment per record; EffectAttempt and NodeExecution must have different consecutive numbers
open_points.default_guess: Increment per send-attempt (shared number across both records of that send).

open_points.subject: Binding digest scope (K-03/M10/M11 vs A08)
open_points.text: K-03 says "A binding pins the manifest record's digest" and M11 says `record_digest` is "the pinned manifest record"; A08 rule 2 says `record_digest` is SHA-256 of "that one capability entry" and test 3 allows edits elsewhere in the service record without staling the binding.
open_points.question: Is staleness pinned to the whole service record digest or only the selected capability entry digest?
options: Pin whole service record digest
Pin only selected capability entry digest
open_points.default_guess: Pin only the selected capability entry digest (A08 is more specific).

open_points.subject: A08 runtime mismatch conditions at send time
open_points.text: A08 rule 6 only defines send refusal for "record absent or its digest differs".
open_points.question: If the capability is now missing/non-invocable or instance config is invalid at invocation, how is the node concluded?
options: Treat all such re-read failures as `operation_failed` with `binding_stale`
Map some to `service_unreachable` or other statuses
Refuse earlier at run advance before invocation
open_points.default_guess: Treat as `operation_failed` `binding_stale` for any manifest re-read mismatch affecting the pinned operation.

open_points.subject: A09 pre-send policy refusals outcome mapping
open_points.text: A09 rule 1/4 says invalid target forms (absolute path/host change/userinfo/fragment, forbidden plain `http`) are "refused before anything is sent", but A09 rule 5 outcome table has no row for these local refusals.
open_points.question: What NodeExecution status (and EffectAttempt status for non-read) must be recorded for these pre-send refusals?
options: `operation_failed` (+ `not_sent` for non-read)
`service_unreachable` (+ `not_sent` for non-read)
Immediate run-level refusal without node execution
open_points.default_guess: Record node `operation_failed`; for non-read record EffectAttempt `not_sent`.

open_points.subject: A09 input-to-request shape and encoding
open_points.text: A09 rule 2: path placeholders take inputs "text-encoded" and "A binding whose inputs do not fit this shape is refused when proposed".
open_points.question: What exact input types/encodings are permitted for path/query/body mapping (especially non-scalars, nulls, arrays, objects)?
options: Allow only scalar JSON values in path/query; refuse others
Define deterministic JSON-string encoding for complex values
Allow complex values only in JSON body for non-GET/DELETE
open_points.default_guess: Allow scalars for path/query; refuse complex values there; allow complex JSON only in JSON body.

open_points.subject: Failure-detail ceiling behavior (A20 vs A03/A09/A15)
open_points.text: A20 rule 2 says "Over a ceiling is always a refusal or a failure, never a truncation"; A03 rule 6 and A09 rule 6 say the kernel keeps "at most `failure_detail_bytes_max`" of text.
open_points.question: Is `failure_detail` over-limit handling truncation (store prefix) or failure/refusal?
options: Truncate failure detail to the max bytes
Fail/refuse when detail exceeds the max
Store nothing when over limit
open_points.default_guess: Truncate failure detail (follow A03/A09/A15 operational text).

open_points.subject: Flow output reporting shape (M19 vs A05/A13)
open_points.text: M19 defines `outputs` as "StoredValues by flow output port, as produced"; A05 rule 4 and A13 rule 7 require outputs reported as `skipped_by_guard` or `not produced` too.
open_points.question: How are `skipped_by_guard`/`not produced` flow outputs represented in run data and surface responses?
options: Extend run output model with per-output status enum + optional value
Represent missing value as absent key and infer status elsewhere
Encode sentinel values in output slots
open_points.default_guess: Per-output status structure with optional value reference.

open_points.subject: Disclosure proof check target on edges to flow outputs
open_points.text: A05 phase 8 says source class must not exceed "the class the target input accepts"; flow output ports in M01 "carry no class".
open_points.question: Does disclosure phase 8 apply to edges ending at flow outputs, and if so against what class bound?
options: Skip disclosure comparison for edges to flow outputs
Require an explicit class on flow outputs for proof
Treat flow output as accepting any class
open_points.default_guess: Skip/accept all edges to flow outputs for disclosure comparison.

open_points.subject: Flow constants targeting flow outputs
open_points.text: A05 phase 6 requires every flow output has "at least one incoming edge or constant"; M16 defines FlowConstant as delivered "to one input port".
open_points.question: Can a FlowConstant target a flow output port, or are constants node-input-only?
options: Allow constants to flow outputs
Disallow constants to flow outputs; phase-6 wording should be edge-only for outputs
open_points.default_guess: Disallow constants to flow outputs (constants target node inputs only).

open_points.subject: A07 agent-visible failure detail for confidential executions
open_points.text: A07 rule 5 returns only "length and the execution's class" when failure detail came from execution above `open`, but NodeExecution M23 has no `execution class` field.
open_points.question: Which class value is returned as "execution's class" and where is it sourced?
options: Highest disclosure class among that execution's received inputs
Highest class among inputs and outputs
Run-level highest class
open_points.default_guess: Use highest disclosure class among that execution's inputs.
